description: Memcached health, traffic, storage, connection and slab diagnostics using only memcached_exporter metrics. Cache limits describe Memcached item storage, not total VM memory.

panels.description: Number of selected targets currently exposing memcached_up. This is discovered membership, not a fixed expected node count.
panels.title: Reporting nodes

panels.description: Sum of memcached_up across reporting targets. A value below Reporting nodes means at least one exporter can be scraped but cannot reach Memcached.
panels.title: Reachable nodes

panels.description: Current item bytes divided by the configured Memcached cache limit across selected nodes. The cache limit is not total VM memory.
panels.title: Cache utilization

panels.description: Current items stored across selected nodes.
panels.title: Stored items

panels.description: Aggregate GET hit rate divided by hit-plus-miss rate. Idle caches display No reads; absent metrics remain Missing data.
panels.title: GET hit ratio

panels.description: Aggregate item eviction rate across selected nodes.
panels.title: Evictions/s

panels.description: memcached_up=0 is Unreachable. If no selected target reports a series, the panel shows Missing data rather than zero.
panels.title: Reachability

panels.description: Current seconds since each Memcached process started. Although exported as a counter, this value is already an uptime duration and is not rated.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Current and configured maximum client connections per node.
panels.title: Connections

panels.description: Item payload bytes, allocated slab-page bytes, and configured cache bytes. None is total VM memory; use the node dashboards for host/VM memory.
panels.title: Item storage, slab allocation and cache limit

panels.description: Current client connections as a percentage of each node's configured maximum.
panels.title: Connection utilization

panels.description: Per-node GET hit and miss rates.
panels.title: GET hit and miss rates

panels.description: All exported Memcached command outcomes by node.
panels.title: Command rates

panels.description: Items evicted under memory pressure and expired items whose memory was reclaimed.
panels.title: Evictions and reclaims

panels.description: Rejected connections and times Memcached disabled its listener after reaching the connection limit.
panels.title: Rejected connections and listener disabling

panels.description: Storage failures caused by the maximum item size or unavailable cache memory.
panels.title: Storage errors

panels.description: Network bytes read and written by each Memcached process per second.
panels.title: Read and write throughput

panels.description: User plus system CPU time consumed per second. One core fully utilized equals 1.0.
panels.title: Memcached process CPU

panels.description: Used chunks divided by currently allocated chunks for each slab class.
panels.title: Chunk utilization

panels.description: Current bytes requested by items in each slab class. This is a current value despite the exporter's unusual source mapping.
panels.title: Requested bytes

panels.description: Current items stored in each slab class.
panels.title: Stored items

panels.description: Per-slab eviction rate.
panels.title: Evictions/s

panels.description: Per-slab out-of-memory error rate.
panels.title: Out-of-memory events/s

panels.description: Current age of the oldest item in each slab class.
panels.title: Oldest-item age

panels.description: Rate of items stored (sets/adds) per node.
panels.title: New items stored/s

panels.description: Seconds since the last item was evicted from each slab class; small values mean memory pressure evicts live items.
panels.title: Time since last eviction

panels.description: Items leaving by expiry (reclaimed, crawler-reclaimed) compared with early eviction. Mostly reclaimed = TTLs are doing the work; mostly evicted = cache is too small for the TTLs.
panels.title: Expiry vs eviction (per node)

panels.description: Items that expired or were evicted without ever being read; high values suggest wasted writes or TTLs that are too short.
panels.title: Unfetched expiries and evictions

panels.description: Age of the oldest item in the hot, warm and overall LRU of each slab class.
panels.title: Item age by LRU segment

panels.description: Item count per LRU segment (hot, warm, cold) summed over the selected slabs.
panels.title: Items by LRU segment
